items.item_text: Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
High school diploma and / or equivalent certification / experience / training
Experience in leading and serving in a high-volume catering, restaurant, or dining service-related field in the past 10 years.
Experience using computerized systems, including food production/procurement systems, and time-keeping programs.
Experience in PCI & managing cash handling policies and procedures.
Experience adjusting to shifting daily priorities and objectives.
Experience utilizing interpersonal communication skills to clearly and effectively interact with individuals of varying backgrounds and perspectives to resolve problems.
Experience using writing skills to prepare a variety of correspondence, reports, policies and procedures, agreements, training documents, and performance evaluations.
Experience setting up and taking down food/beverage service stations/buffets and serving formal plated meals.

Under the general direction of the Catering and Concession General Manager, the Catering and Concessions Service Lead is responsible for assisting in the execution of catering and concession events daily. This position is responsible for providing and leading event operation support, providing excellent customer service, maintaining cashiering service standards and cash handling compliance. Additionally, this role will provide basic culinary support to the Catering and Concessions operation.

The Catering and Concessions Service Lead will ensure department service standards are met and business goals are attained. Provide mentorship to the catering service and culinary team and monitor adherence to customer service standards, and cash handling compliance.
This position will be expected to uphold the highest level of confidentiality as they will serve and lead private events.
Must be willing and able to drive all vehicles.
This position would additionally support other Dining units when in need of service assistance, including both Residential and Retail units.
Knowledge of related Federal, State, Local, and UC regulations.
